hooks.name: Sync spec after task completion
hooks.description: After each spec task is completed, remind Kiro to update the task checklist in the spec file and verify that the implementation follows the product principles from the spec.

action.prompt:
A spec task has just been completed. Do the following:
1. Update the task checklist in .kiro/specs/personal-memory-os.md — mark the completed task with [x]
2. Verify the implementation follows the product principles:
   - AI suggests, user confirms important actions
   - AI interprets; deterministic systems execute
   - Never silently lose a reminder
   - Every AI answer is traceable to stored memory
3. If any principle is not yet met, note it as a follow-up task.
